item.title: Carrie Officially Coming Back for Season 2 on Prime Video
item.description: After a chart-topping streaming debut on Prime Video, Mike Flanagan and Stephen King's television series Carrie is returning for season 2, Amazon MGM Studios confirmed Thursday in an official announcement. Flanagan and King are set to return for the second season of Carrie , which will send the psychokinetic high-schooler into uncharted territory, given how season 1 of the hit horror show ended .

item.title: How to find and clear compounds in DMZ in Modern Warfare 4
item.description: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 DMZ compounds are another new mechanic added to the extraction shooter, and just like the lieutenant towers , you need to "clear a compound" to complete the "No One Left" order, which is in the first set of the "Human Intel" chapter. Hajin is a big map, though, so compounds aren't easy to find in DMZ.

item.title: 'Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3' Officially Delayed and Fans Are Delighted
item.description: Dragon Ball fans are quite opinionated, as the response to the upcoming action-RPG Dragon Ball Xenoverse 3 has made clear . While many fans were excited to hear Xenoverse would return after more than a decade, their enthusiasm cooled when developer Dimps revealed early footage of the game. One design change in particular drew significant backlash: going Super Saiyan would have a time limit .

item.title: Nintendo Switch 2 Suffers Major Exploit in Latest AI-Assisted Hack
item.description: If you've ever thought to yourself, "You know what would make Mario Kart a better game?" and answered " Family Guy 's Peter Griffin," then you must be really fun at parties. I do have some good news for you, though. A modder has jailbroken the Nintendo Switch 2 to allow players to have their way with the console. This was accomplished, of course, with the help of generative AI in the latest example of how technology is plaguing the games industry .

item.title: Chris Pratt Officially Confirms Star-Lord's Return to the MCU
item.description: We haven't seen Chris Pratt's Star-Lord in the Marvel Cinematic Universe since 2023, when James Gunn's Guardians of the Galaxy trilogy definitively concluded . Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3 ended on a hard reset for Star-Lord (aka Peter Quill), with the intergalactic hero returning to Earth and finding new purpose: enjoying Terran cereal and contemplating an amateur career in landscaping.

item.title: How to get electronic sensors in DMZ in Modern Warfare 4
item.description: Every single player will need to find electronic sensors in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's DMZ mode, because they're an essential resource early on. They're used for all sorts of upgrades and recipes, including increasing your stash size , unlocking additional purchase options at the vendor, crafting various field upgrades and fire support, and more.

item.title: How to increase stash size in DMZ in Modern Warfare 4
item.description: One problem that everyone is going to encounter in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's DMZ mode is how to increase your stash size . It's a common recurrence in pretty much every extraction shooter, because your stash always has limited space. I'm pleased to report that you can upgrade your stash and increase the number of items you can store in DMZ, but figuring out how is a task in itself.
